semiconductor_relevance: High — Meiko Electronics specializes in semiconductor package substrates and related technologies, making it a key player in the packaging segment of the semiconductor industry.
summary: Meiko Electronics is a total solutions provider in the electronics field, focusing on printed circuit board design and manufacturing technology. They offer a range of semiconductor package substrates and component-embedded substrates, catering to the needs of the semiconductor industry with advanced heat dissipation and miniaturization technologies.
capabilities: ABF substrates compatible with FCBGA and CSP
high heat dissipation copper base substrates

regional_presence.Japan: Meiko has a global production system for semiconductor package substrates in Japan.
regional_presence.Vietnam: The company also operates a production facility in Vietnam to support its semiconductor packaging operations.
